sections.content: You know *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27. *Es necesario que* and *es fundamental que* work the same way. This lesson uses them to say what should happen in public life: the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive (*respeten*, *escuche*, *haya*) because the action has not happened yet.

items.spanish: Es necesario que todos respeten la ley.
items.english: It is necessary that everyone respect the law.

items.spanish: Es importante que el gobierno escuche a la gente.
items.english: It is important that the government listens to people.

items.spanish: Es fundamental que haya reglas claras.
items.english: It is essential that there be clear rules.

sections.content: The expression judges an action that has not happened yet, so the verb after *que* is in the subjunctive, whether the trigger is *necesario*, *importante* or *fundamental*.
